title: More Wolf Pelts
description: More Wolf Pelts — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Lee of York

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 20 Wolf Pelts from the Wolves and Wolf Pups in Dew Valley Forest

Quest Reward: 750 Gold

Return to: Sir Lee of York

Repeatable: Yes

Note: Before Build 130 this quest was given by Samford the Hermit.

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect another 20 Wolf Pelts in Dew Valley Forest. Afterward, return to Sir Lee of York in Dew Valley.

Offer:

Thou hast done a most excellent, er.... Ah, forget it.

Look, both you know and I know that you're not even listening to me anymore. Just go out into Dew Valley Forest, kill every wolf you see, bring me back the pelts, and we'll get along just fine.

Tip: Typically, you cannot re-do a quest after you have completed it and turned it in. However, some quests can be repeated. These quests can often be identified by the appearance of words like another or more in their titles or descriptions.

Turn-in:

Thanks for the pelts. I can use some of them as seat cushions. Now, if only I had something to sit on.

Objectives:

  • Wolf Pelt ×20

Client level range: 3–10
